name: @mcp-shim/local-crm
description: Customer-side CRM Type 1 MCP. Today it talks to the local mock customer service over HTTP and needs no third-party SDKs. When it grows real CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, etc.) declare those SDKs in a `dependencies` block here — they stay local to this folder so they don't bloat the connector workspace.
